visualCharacteristics: Responsive grid of user cards (1/2/3/4 columns at mobile/600px/900px/1200px). Each card shows an initials avatar, the user's name as a heading, email as a mailto link, gender, and an active/inactive status badge.
contentPattern: Empty block, no authored fields. Data is fetched client-side from the usersApiUrl variable in the public site configuration (normally the App Builder proxy), which must return a JSON array of {id, name, email, gender, status}.
usage: Add the block to a page; there is nothing to author. The API address is managed in the site configuration (usersApiUrl) and App Builder.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any endpoint returning the same user record shape. For other data shapes create a new block.
